JSTS Weeknight Rides (Jersey Shore Touring Society)

Red Bank, NJ · Road

JSTS Weeknight Rides (Jersey Shore Touring Society) is a road group ride in Red Bank, NJ. It rolls tuesdays and Wednesdays and Thursdays at 4:30 pm from Varies by day: Michael J. Tighe Park, Freehold (Tue); Holmdel Park (Wed); Brookdale Community College, Lincroft (Thu).

How we know

JSTS's ride calendar for October 2026 lists the weeknight rides at 4:45 pm the week of Sept 29 (5:00 pm for one Thursday group), 4:30 pm on Oct 6 to 8 and 4:00 pm on Oct 13 to 15, with no weeknight evening rides after Oct 15 and only morning weekday rides from Oct 20 (read Oct 1, 2026).

About the JSTS Weeknight Rides (Jersey Shore Touring Society) group ride

A Monmouth County club that says its focus is social, not competitive. The September calendar shows Tuesday and Wednesday evening rides of 18 to 27 miles in several pace groups, plus long weekend rides. Outdoor rides are members-only with advance sign-up; a free trial membership gets you in the door.
